summary: Added a separate bounded native structural text/Markdown adapter over verified approved originals and provenance contracts. It groups paragraphs, headings, procedure items, fenced code and a documented pipe-table subset while preserving exact Unicode source coverage and distinct source scopes.
API: structured_text.extract(store, revision_id, StructurePolicy|None) returns StructureResult with revision, scope, policy-bound dependency, ordered native blocks, exact half-open Unicode code-point coverage and bounded-subset uncertainty. Input-free StructureError on failure; no PDF/model/tokenizer execution.

tests.command: uv run --isolated --locked --python 3.14 pytest -o addopts='' -q tests/unit/test_structured_text.py tests/integration/test_structured_text_composition.py tests/unit/test_text_extraction.py tests/integration/test_text_extraction_composition.py tests/unit/test_source_admission.py tests/unit/test_source_cli.py tests/integration/test_source_admission_composition.py tests/unit/test_provenance_records.py tests/integration/test_provenance_records_composition.py
git diff --check and cmp copied order to lane order

evidence: Owned OriginalStore -> extraction -> Registry composes metadata revisions and distinct ACL/corpus/rights for shared bytes; exact CRLF, astral, combining, blank, warnings, procedure continuations, code, repeated table headers/rows and injection/link text reconstruct via every coverage range. Cross-revision binding refused.

Determinism and policy changes affect extraction/block identities; byte, character, line, block and unit-size limits, invalid/forged policies, invalid UTF-8/PDF, corruption, descriptor-read mutation and cooperative deadline all refuse without partial results. The byte-cap witness observes zero blob reads when source size exceeds the policy.
limitations: Local candidate only; no canonical integration, acceptance, PR, merge or CI certification.

Limited structural subset is not full CommonMark, semantic validation, token-aware chunking or proof of quality on real corpus. Empty originals explicitly produce zero blocks. Five-second deadline is cooperative and cannot interrupt blocking filesystem calls.
No PDF import or backend invocation, new dependency, license exception, vision, model, GPU or service qualification. Full 006, ICA and MVP remain open.
